name.ja: ねこぶそう てんこ盛り

categories.ja: キャラクタープラモデル

description.ja: 可愛い ねこには「ぶそう」をさせよう―。新感覚「ねこ」Hobby現る。
description.en: Let's let the cute cat "buso ". A new sensation " cat" Hobby appears.

description.ja: • ねこ原型師×ねこ好きモデラーのコラボレーション!
description.en: • Collaboration between cat sculptor and cat-loving modeler!

description.ja: • 「ねこ」フィギュアに「ジャケット」を着せ「ぶそう」パーツを装備させて楽しもう。
description.en: • Let's enjoy wearing the "jacket " on the " cat " figure and equipping it with " buso" parts.

description.ja: • 「ねこ」は全長約5cm。ねこ造形作家として活躍中の森口修氏の原型により、表情や毛並み、肉球など、細部に至るまで造形。
description.en: • The total length of the "cat" is approximately 5cm. Based on the prototype by Osamu Moriguchi, who is active as a cat sculptor, every detail including facial expressions, fur, and paws has been sculpted.

description.ja: • 「ぶそう」はフリーモデラーのフクダカズヤ氏のデザインで、緻密なメカ造形とユニークな合体形態を追求。
description.en: • "Buso" was designed by freelance modeler Kazuya Fukuda, pursuing precise mechanical modeling and a unique combination form.

description.ja: • 「ぶそう」は単独でミニメカ状態にも組み替え可能！ジャケットや各ぶそうに搭載された3mmジョイントにより組み合わせは自由自在。
description.en: • "Buso" can be rearranged into a mini-mecha state by itself! You can freely combine them with the 3mm joints installed on the jacket and each bush.

description.ja: • 〈てんこ盛り〉は一箱で全ての「ぶそう」がそろうまさに“てんこ盛り”なセット！• このセットでしか手に入らない立ちねこポーズの「くつした」と特別カラーの「ぶそう+α」入り。
description.en: • 〈Tenkomori〉 is a truly “Tenkomori” set that has all the “Buso” items in one box! • Includes a standing cat pose "Skutsuta " and a special color " Buso+α" that can only be obtained with this set.

contents.ja: 彩色済ねこフィギュア×1
